race.comment: MONT SAINT MICHEL (2) flashed home to finish third two back over 1200m at Moe. Didn't appreciate dropping back in distance at Geelong last time in a run worth overlooking. Today's journey looks an ideal fit now. NICKING GRACIE (9) enjoyed getting beyond 1200m for the first time in the campaign when a handy third over 1400m at Hamilton last time out, leading until claimed late in proceedings. Rock hard fit after four runs back and should enjoy a perfect run from an inside draw. FLYING SHELBY (6) has been freshened up since dropping out over 2400m at Swan Hill on 27 October. Might surprise coming back in grade while a bit on the new side. STEELY HUSTLER (10) is knocking on the door after consecutive placings, the latest over 1400m at Hamilton. In form mare who has the ability to test this field. Veteran ALPINOVA (8) has been finding the line with gusto in shorter races. One to watch for late in the piece.
